comment: save.c savelev():560-563 clear_level_structures() under release_data(), which do.c goto_level() reaches when it leaves a level. It calls rect.c init_rect(), so after returning to a visited level the free rectangles are one whole-map rectangle, not whatever making the level just left consumed. A human Valkyrie in debug mode level-teleports to Dlvl 3 and back to Dlvl 1 with ^V, then runs #wizloadlua Pri-filb, whose random des.room() calls draw rn2(rect_cnt) in rect.c rnd_rect(). Seed, datetime, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
